Name: Athena by Shoplazza
Tagline: An orchestrator agent for your entire commerce stack
Description: Athena helps you build a polished, launch-ready store with complete pages, products, and localized copy. From there, it keeps the business moving by creating products in bulk, setting up discounts, configuring shipping, and launching ad campaigns. Payments, logistics, fulfillment, and loyalty are built into the same platform, so the store Athena creates is not just a storefront. It is ready to operate as a real business.

Name: BrainFeed
Tagline: A personalized learning feed that redirects your scroll
Description: BrainFeed is a personalized learning feed designed to redirect your scrolling habit and build compounding knowledge. Set a custom goal like "how to get my first 100 users," or drop in a link to that long article or YouTube video you’ve been avoiding. BrainFeed transforms them into a bite-sized, scrollable feed of cards that you can easily get through while waiting in a line. Unlike traditional feeds, BrainFeed uses spaced repetition to ensure you actually retain what you read.

Name: SF Apartment Finder
Tagline: Tinder for live SF rentals from across the web
Description: Criblist turns SF apartment hunting into a swipeable deck. Set your budget, neighborhoods, and must-haves, then browse live rentals from Craigslist and local property managers. Context.dev powers the extraction and source data. Keep the good ones.

Name: TouchGrass
Tagline: Context-aware break reminders without invasive permissions
Topics: Health & Fitness, Productivity, Menu Bar Apps
Description: TouchGrass is a context-aware break reminder built for macOS. Most break reminders only know one thing: time. TouchGrass waits through meetings, calls, media playback and screen recordings, counts time away from your Mac as a completed break, and reminds you to blink, improve your posture and rest after long typing sessions. Everything runs locally, never asks for Accessibility permission, and respects your workflow. 7 day free trial, then a one time purchase of $3.99 with lifetime updates.

Name: Pulse Island
Tagline: A living island for your Mac's notch
Description: Pulse turns your MacBook's notch into a Dynamic Island: Be it music, meetings, clipboard, weather, focus timers, devices and live system stats, one glance up.

Name: Openbase
Tagline: Manage your team of AI agents by voice, from anywhere
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Tech
Description: Openbase lets you manage a team of AI coding agents by voice, from anywhere; no screen, no desk. AI agents can work async, but supervising them still pulls you back to a laptop. OpenBase fixes that. Dispatch tasks, steer agents mid-work, and approve changes just by talking. The agents write code, control your computer, open PRs, commit and push; you stay in control from your phone. Works across providers and syncs to your machine, so you pick up at your desk right where you left off.

Name: Yoggi
Tagline: Safe AI chat for kids
Description: Yoggi is the AI assistant built for children aged 3–15. Age-adapted answers, live voice chat, image generation, strict content filtering, and parental controls. Free on iOS and Android.

Name: PureBox.ai
Tagline: Review-first AI cleanup for your real Gmail inbox.
Description: Most inbox tools make you build rules first. PureBox skips that - it's personalized from your first scan using AI and your own Gmail history (which senders you open, reply to, or let pile up), so suggestions fit your routine on day one. Every suggestion shows why, and nothing moves until you approve - no black box, no silent deletions. It surfaces what needs your attention, not just what to trash. Your data is never sold; Pro subscriptions fund it.

Name: KeyOpera 2.0
Tagline: Make every Mac keystroke sound uniquely yours
Description: KeyOpera adds satisfying keyboard and mouse sounds to your Mac. V2 introduces customkeypak sound packs, one-click Finder installs, a Homebrew CLI for creating and controlling packs, spoken key names, improved VoiceOver support, and a redesigned menu.

Name: Forgeon
Tagline: Create, publish, and experience interactive stories
Description: Every generation reinvents the way stories are told. We believe books are next. Forgeon is a platform where authors create interactive stories with choices, RPG mechanics, music, illustrations, and more. We don't build AI authors—we build better tools for creators. We believe books can be as engaging as any game, movie, or series.

Name: >=PlayingFild
Tagline: Productivity Tool & Tab Manager that Understands Context
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Productivity, User Experience, Tech
Description: ≻=PlayingFild uses on device machine learning to classify tabs by content, not URL. The same website can be productive or distracting based on the page. Classification happens entirely on your device. Raw page content, HTML and personal text don't leave your browser. Earn break time by focusing and spend it when you need it. Tabs reorder themselves based on what you actually use, and unused tabs close. Includes per window rules, focus timer modes, recap cards, and productivity analytics.

Name: CodexBar Lite
Tagline: Privacy-first Codex tracker for your macOS menu bar
Topics: Privacy, Developer Tools, GitHub, Menu Bar Apps
Description: CodexBar Lite is a native macOS menu bar app that keeps your OpenAI Codex usage visible at a glance. It uses your existing Codex CLI session - no browser cookies, Keychain permissions, API keys, or third-party accounts required. Monitor usage, reset times, and receive notifications, all from a lightweight, open-source app.

Name: AppUFO
Tagline: Ship localised Apps faster
Description: Reach more users worldwide without spending days or hundreds on app localisation. Localise your Xcode projects in minutes, reduce translation costs, and spend less time managing strings so you can focus on building great apps.

Name: yatta!
Tagline: A cute little to-do list that celebrates with you
Description: A cute, tiny to-do list where a character celebrates every task you finish — with fireworks and a happy "yatta!" ("I did it!" in Japanese). Just three choices: Today, Later, or Someday. No projects, no priorities, no clutter. Free core features, fully offline.

Name: Aymo AI
Tagline: All-in-one AI Platform for Teams
Description: Get access to latest models of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Kimi, GLM and 45+ top AI models in one secure workspace with powerful team features. Compare outputs AI model response side by side, upload and chat with files, search the web, generate images, and collaborate with your team on every plan. Free and decent plans that can replace a dozen AI tools: Bundled with a Chrome extension, apps, useful AI tools, and AI Docs on the way.

Name: AdMapix
Tagline: Your AI research agent for 200M+ ads
Description: AdMapix helps growth teams find competitors’ newest ad creatives, understand what is working, and turn insights into new campaign ideas. It is also one of the highest-ranked advertising Skills on Clawhub, already used by tens of thousands of AI-agent users. Search global ads, ask AI agents to analyze competitor strategy, then generate fresh ad concepts and copy for your next tests.

Name: Pawesome
Tagline: Your AI Native Inbound Marketing Engine
Description: Pawesome is a full AI-native inbound engine for B2B SaaS: Content Engine, Lead Collection, and Analytics, built on a brain that knows your company.

Name: Maptoolkit.org - free vector map server
Tagline: Stunning vector maps. Zero cost. No sign-up, no API key.
Description: Maptoolkit.org is a free, production-grade vector tile server built on OpenStreetMap and MapLibre. It delivers fast, customizable vector basemaps with 3D terrain, hillshading, and outdoor styles - provacy-aware with no sign-up, no API keys, no cookies, and no request limits for open-source, indie, and small-business projects.

Name: Scaloom
Tagline: Safe Reddit account warmup tool for founders & marketers
Description: Reddit is full of high-intent buyers, but self-promotion leads to instant bans. Scaloom is your AI-powered Reddit marketing assistant that lets you acquire customers safely. • 🛡️ Account Warmup Engine: Build trust & karma risk-free • 🔍 Real-Time Lead Radar: Spot buyer questions 24/7 • 🤖 AI-Crafted Replies: Contextual drafts with 1-click human approval • 💡 Viral Post Inspiration & Analytics Get the speed of AI with 100% human control. Start your 7-day free trial today!

Name: Braidkeep
Tagline: Catch merge conflicts before your AI agents break main
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Run several AI coding agents in parallel and their branches collide the moment you merge — and you find out one at a time, after every agent has finished. Braidkeep predicts conflicts between in-flight branches using Git's own merge-tree (read-only, never touches your working tree), enforces per-agent file ownership, and computes a safe merge order: conflict-free batches first, tangles last. Any orchestrator. Single binary, Apache-2.0, free. Predicts mergeability, not correctness.
